description: Source code for the Node IP Address Management (NodeIPAM) controller in Kubernetes cloud-controller-manager, demonstrating how cloud providers add external controllers, including functions for starting the controller, processing CIDRs, and setting node CIDR mask sizes.

classes.name: nodeIPAMController
classes.description: Struct holding configuration options for the NodeIPAM controller.

methods.name: StartNodeIpamControllerWrapper
methods.description: Initializes and starts the NodeIPAM controller, validating options and applying configuration.

methods.name: startNodeIpamController
methods.description: Sets up and runs the NodeIPAM controller, processing CIDRs and configuring node CIDR masks.

methods.name: processCIDRs
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of CIDRs and determines if they represent a dual-stack configuration.

methods.name: setNodeCIDRMaskSizes
methods.description: Determines IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR mask sizes based on configuration and cluster CIDRs, with validation for dual-stack and single-stack clusters.
